1.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 1 | CC
1.description: Agriculture master's grad Xu Yan bombs a job interview, then wakes up in a thunderstorm as a penniless scholar in Liuxi Village, 20 taels in debt, with a Matchmaker System in his head. An officer kicks in the door with a marriage decree: three brides, married today. "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 1.

2.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 2 | CC
2.description: Xu Yan has three days to marry three brides, or the System erases him. Qin Shuang wants him to chop firewood first, Tang Xiaotang wants a household registration, not a husband, and A-Ling won't say a word. Then Squire Qian shows up with his servants to take people in place of the 20 taels. "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 2.

3.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 3 | CC
3.description: A hatchet thuds into the doorframe, and Qin Shuang says one word: "Let go." Squire Qian wants the three brides written into the bond; Xu Yan cites the Daheng Code and pledges his house, his land and himself instead: 20 taels in three days. The System's starter pack is a blurry soap recipe. He pays A-Ling a smooth compliment, and her affection drops to -5 on the spot. At midnight by the stove, A-Ling, who has never spoken a word, asks him a question. "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 3.

4.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 4 | CC
4.description: One line from Xu Yan, "People aren't things," brings A-Ling's affection back from -5 to -2. Next day, soap takes lard, wood ash and a big pot, and the house has one bowl of rice left. Tang Xiaotang flings open a chest of gold with a bang to pay his debt, but he shuts the lid. Xiaohe gathers ash, Erniu hauls the pot, Qin Shuang drags home a wild boar, and the first batch of soap starts to boil. At midnight, someone is standing by the pot, holding up a bucket of water. "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 4.

5.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 5 | CC
5.description: At midnight Lai San, a servant of the Qian household, pours water into Xu Yan's soap pot, until a dagger whistles through the air and pins him to a pillar. Xu Yan doesn't beat him; he makes him stir the pot all night. At dawn the molds come off, and the first batch of snow-white soap lathers up. Mid-count, the System panel suddenly turns red: Married 0/3, 12 double-hours left. "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 5.

31.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 31 | CC
31.description: A gust of wind tears A-Ling's veil away, and Wei Shaoqing freezes in the doorway: "You're… you're…" She pulls the veil back over her face, her voice as cold as well water: "You've got the wrong person." He backs up two steps, mounts his horse and rides off. That night she sits on the rim of the well, the moonlight turning her face almost translucent, and says only, "He saw me once, inside very high walls," and "Don't ask again." Xu Yan nods: "Fine. I won't." And her affection goes up. Not one drop of rain in three months. Xu Yan wraps the rice seed from a reward chest in damp cloth, and the very day the white sprouts show, three days later, Liuxi Creek runs dry; the creek bed cracks all the way to the horizon, while Squire Qian shuts his gates, hoards grain and raises prices. The System issues a drought mission: get water to Liuxi's fields within ten days. Fail, and the seedlings die. The villagers follow the creek upstream and find the Qian household building a dam to divert the last of the water into Qian fields. Erniu charges with his hoe raised, and a dozen staves rise to meet him. "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 31, the start of the fourth arc of Season 1.

32.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 32 | CC
32.description: Before Erniu's hoe can land, a long staff sweeps in from the side and knocks it flying. Qin Shuang stands between the two mobs: "Fight, and you hand him his excuse." One by one the Qian staves come down, and the two villages don't come to blows. The deep pool below Liuxi still holds water, but the water is low and the fields are high, so Xu Yan says just two words: dig wells. Under a blazing sun, twelve well pits line up in a row; by day three not one has hit water. Xu Yan ties on a rope and goes down himself, digs all day, and comes up caked in mud, then a second later topples straight backward. Qin Shuang hoists him onto her shoulder and strides across the threshing yard, calling him a "soft bookworm" even as her ears turn red. Affection 41. The gold reward chest clicks open: blueprints for a waterwheel. Old Shi the carpenter reads them and says only, "Three hundred catties of good timber. Where do we find that?" The village's big trees were all cut down last year; only one piece of timber that size is left: the beam of the ancestral hall. At dusk, Elder Han leads the whole village to kneel before the ancestral tablets: "We take down the hall's beam, so the children get a mouthful of water." Every head turns toward Xu Yan, standing in the doorway. "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 32.

33.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 33 | CC
33.description: Xu Yan kneels before the ancestral tablets, a row of white-haired elders kneeling beside him: "We borrow the beam." "It comes back in three years." Elder Han bows his forehead to the floor: "If the ancestors are angry, let them blame this old man." Dozens of villagers carry the ancestral hall's old beam across the cracked fields, the setting sun stretching their long line of shadows across the ground. The System coldly reminds him: drought mission, seven days left. Old Shi the carpenter looks over the blueprints and says only that it can't be built in seven days; with a single "You lead the men, I'll draw," Xu Yan stakes the beam on himself. Qin Shuang stands up high waving a flag and splits every able-bodied man in the village into three rotating shifts, while Tang Xiaotang trades sugar from the sugar workshop for thirty pounds of iron nails. Squire Qian brings in a geomancer, who stands on the field ridge shouting, "Tear down the ancestral hall, and heaven will strike you down!" Eight-year-old Xiaohe plants her hands on her hips and fires back, "The ancestors are thirsty too!" The whole village bursts out laughing, and the geomancer flees. Seven days of work, day and night, and the day the waterwheel's frame finally stands is the very day the drought mission runs out. The whole village gathers by the canal, the sluice gate opens, and the waterwheel creaks through half a turn — then stops, and doesn't move again. Up on the field ridge, Squire Qian roars with laughter. "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 33, from the fourth arc of Season 1.

34.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 34 | CC
34.description: On the day of the water test, the sluice gate opens, the waterwheel creaks through half a turn and stops, and Squire Qian doubles over laughing on the field ridge. Xiaohe puffs out her cheeks and blows on her paper pinwheel: "Brother, it's turning backward." Xu Yan sees it at once: the blades are angled against this stretch of current. All twelve have to be flipped before sunset, and the drought mission expires at sunset today. Qin Shuang's three shifts flip every one of them in two hours. Elder Han opens the gate with his own hands; the waterwheel creaks into motion, turning faster and faster, its buckets lifting water from the pool high into the air and tipping it into the canal. The surge rushes across the cracked fields, Elder Han kneels and scoops up the muddy water in his hands, and for the first time the whole village calls Xu Yan "Mr. Xu." Overnight, Squire Qian's dam becomes useless, and the System reports the mission complete and the rice seed saved. The village is still cheering when Xiaohe's paper pinwheel suddenly spins the other way. The northern sky goes dark, and a black, droning cloud rolls over the hills — locusts. "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 34.

35.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 35 | CC
35.description: Locusts pelt the paper windows like hail, and Xu Yan says just one word: "Ducks." Tang Xiaotang pushes her abacus aside: "How many do you want?" Three thousand — every duck in three counties — and they're half the silver short. He stakes the credit of Xu and Co. and the whole family on her judgment, and her affection jumps to 45. The ducks arrive at the village entrance, the cage doors swing open, and three thousand ducks scatter in every direction; Xu Yan lunges, catches nothing, and ends up with a duck sitting on his legs. The locusts are already over the hill. Then A-Ling, the coldest of them all, walks over with a long bamboo pole on her shoulder and whistles through two fingers, and all three thousand ducks turn their heads at once. One short whistle, and a white line pours into the fields: whole swaths of locusts are eaten, and the black cloud overhead thins bit by bit. Squire Qian sneers, "Ducks against locusts?" and a second later a duck pecks his sleeve. The neighboring village is stripped bare while Liuxi stays green; the neighbors bow to Xu Yan, and the main mission, "The Realm's Hearts," jumps from 1% to 2%. So what it was counting all along wasn't just wives. At dusk, a hundred-odd refugees, old folks and children in tow, crowd the village gate. From the gatehouse Squire Qian shouts, "Shut the gate! There isn't enough grain!" Xu Yan's hand rests on the gate bar. "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 35.

36.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 36 | CC
36.description: Squire Qian shouts "Shut the gate!" from the gatehouse, but Xu Yan pulls the bar open instead: "Whoever comes in eats." "But you work." The grain will last only two months, so he has the hundred-odd refugees dig a canal in exchange for food: every ten feet dug earns a bowl. Tang Xiaotang hands out the rations, A-Ling keeps the register, and the new canal cuts its way along the foot of the hills. But Qin Shuang has her eye on three men in the line: their shoes are new, the webs of their hands between thumb and forefinger are thick with calluses, and they keep asking where "that woman who never talks" lives. In the Qian mansion, the grain hoarded through the whole dry season loses half its price overnight. By candlelight A-Ling bends over the register, each line of her small, neat characters as proper as a palace document. Tang Xiaotang stares, stunned; A-Ling says only, "It's just handwriting." Xu Yan nods: "No questions." At midnight, the three men in new shoes slip over the wall and vanish. Drums sound from the distant hills, and hundreds of torches stream down the slopes — bandits. The village has only a few dozen able-bodied men. How can they hold it? "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 36.

37.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 37 | CC
37.description: Hundreds of torches stream down the hillside. Qin Shuang tears off her coarse cloth shawl, cinches her hair into a high ponytail with a black cord, and takes an old red-tasseled spear down from the ancestral hall's wall: "On my command." Four hundred bandits, sixty able-bodied men in the village, and no wall. Xu Yan says: we don't hold the village gate, we hold the head of the canal. He buries sacks of lime and digs pits along the new canal, and Qin Shuang lines the men up in three rows. She tells him to get down; he says, "I'm standing here, with you." The bandits charge, and clouds of lime billow up, swallowing their torches one by one, while the men at the front drop into the pits one after another. A band of them circles around to the Xu family's back door, where there are only women and children; Tang Xiaotang raises a wooden bucket of boiling water, and A-Ling blocks the doorway with a short dagger in hand. The bandit chief Diao Qi claws his way out of a pit and lunges at the canal head, and with one thrust of her spear Qin Shuang knocks the blade from his hand. Amid the cheering, Xiaohe runs over and throws herself into her brother's arms — and a second later goes limp and collapses, her little face frighteningly hot. "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 37.

38.title: Farm, Marry, Conquer Ep. 38 | CC
38.description: Amid the cheers after the bandits are driven off, Xiaohe throws herself into Xu Yan's arms and goes limp, her little face frighteningly hot. Delirious with fever, she murmurs, "Straw hat… red string… don't push Brother…" Who is she talking about? There's no doctor in the village, the county town is under curfew because of the bandits and its gates stay shut at night, and it's an hour's ride she can't wait out. A-Ling sets down the basin of water and walks out the door: "Give me the horse." Xu Yan asks nothing and puts the horse Tang Wanjin left them in her hands: "I trust you." The way she leaps into the saddle — even Qin Shuang can tell it's how cavalry mount. A lone rider gallops down the moonlit highway. At the town gate the guards laugh, "What's a woman doing on a horse?" She presses in her heels, and the horse sails clean over the wooden barricade. At the clinic door she pounds and calls for Doctor Bai, while behind her a row of crossbows takes aim at her back all at once and the captain raises his hand: "Loose—" "Farm, Marry, Conquer" — Episode 38.
